WEALTH.TITLE: Distribution module
WEALTH.SUB_TITLE: Understanding Currency Inequality with the Gini Coefficient
WEALTH.SUMMARY: This module allows you to visualize the distribution of currency between members, thanks to the Gini index.
WEALTH.SUMMARY2: The Gini index measures the inequalities of distribution (often income or wealth) within a population.
WEALTH.SUMMARY3: The total amount is distributed differently depending on the parameter P. 💸
WEALTH.SUMMARY4: A low P means a more equal distribution. 🤝
WEALTH.SUMMARY5: A high P creates more differences between people. 📊
WEALTH.DESCRIPTION: This graph visualizes the distribution of wealth across different currency types: euro, dollar, bitcoin, or free money. Each monetary system creates different dynamics: some favor the concentration of wealth, others a more equitable distribution. By adjusting the sliders, you can change the monetary distribution. You can observe how these choices influence the Gini coefficient, a simple indicator that measures inequality.
WEALTH.SUMMARY7: The Gini index measures the inequalities of distribution (often income or wealth) within a population.
WEALTH.SUMMARY9: - 1 = complete inequality (only one person has everything)
WEALTH.SUMMARY10: ☝️ In free currency, the Gini index tends permanently towards 0.
